title: Netflix's Qwikster Mistake: Right Strategy, Wrong Way to Do It
notes:
In 2011 Netflix knew streaming was the future. Then it hiked prices 60% and tried to split its DVD service into a new brand called Qwikster, lost 800,000 US subscribers in one quarter, and reversed course in about three weeks. What went wrong, what Netflix got right, and how to change your own business without losing the people who pay you. #business #netflix #entrepreneurship

Today's lesson: Being right about the future is not enough: don't make your customers pay for your transition.
